final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) as account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), totals AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_accounts, COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) as num_districts FROM account) SELECT dc.district_id, dc.account_count, CAST(dc.account_count AS REAL) / t.total_accounts as share, (CAST(dc.account_count AS REAL) / t.total_accounts) - (CAST(1 AS REAL) / t.num_districts) as difference FROM district_counts dc CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
